title: Restore green CI and modernize GitHub Actions
description: Run gofmt on the failing CLI test, upgrade checkout and setup-go to Node 24 action majors, and configure dependency caching for a dependency-free module without expecting go.sum. Verify both scripts/check.sh and scripts/check.ps1.

comments.message: Updated CI to checkout@v5 and setup-go@v6 (Node 24 majors), with setup-go cache keys based on go.mod because this dependency-free module has no go.sum. Confirmed internal/cli/cli_test.go is gofmt-clean. Verification passed: ./scripts/check.sh and pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/check.ps1.
